goal.objective: Advance the first real governed Base validation entry through credential-free Inventory N observation and then the existing TV/TVC/vault provider-capability boundary, stopping before any wallet signature or broadcast.
success_predicates: A fresh complete Base Asset Lounge Inventory N is observed for the canonical wallet from locally materialized StegFin code
The observation uses the hash-bound StegFin registry endpoint and requires no provider capability
The exact 12.50 USDC -> WETH request is repository-resident and fail-closed to its canonical wallet, amount, gas, slippage and reserve boundaries
Trust-registry approval for the real live path is TV/TVC fenced and bound to current Inventory N plus successor claim/fence
The live pretrade source is hardened so operator-supplied provider secret references and credential-bearing RPC inputs are not accepted
Provider credential use is limited to the pinned TV/TVC-governed non-exportable vault capability
No GitHub token, GitHub runtime, hosted scheduler, wallet credential, provider credential, signing authority or broadcast authority is required
The task advances to the separately authorized STEGFIN-LIVE-PRETRADE-005 TV/TVC/vault successor without implementing a competing resolver
failure_predicates: A partial declared-token observation is treated as complete Inventory N
A GitHub token or GitHub Actions runtime becomes a production prerequisite
A GitHub-derived or otherwise non-TV/TVC trust-registry approval is used for the real live trade
An operator-supplied API key, provider token, provider secret reference, or credential-bearing RPC becomes an execution prerequisite
Provider capability material enters worker JSON, environment, log, hash, receipt or repository state
The heartbeat grants credential, wallet-signing or transaction-broadcast authority
The worker duplicates the canonical TVC provider-capability resolver

After the sovereign carrier is active, this task owns credential-free authoritative Inventory N observation only. The separately authorized STEGFIN-LIVE-PRETRADE-005 successor owns TV/TVC route/lease/vault orchestration to the USER_ONLY wallet handoff.
